goals.objective: Continue LifeThread from commit 890e237 on codex/free-chatgpt-sync. Preserve Supabase auth, secrets, the main checkout, and the user-owned project markdown. Validate the landed account/sign-out and dashboard-card progress behavior when a live authenticated session exists. Then implement and verify Supabase Realtime/refetch behavior for authenticated multi-goal changes without paid API requirements. Use failing-first proofs, delegate edits and QA, capture current-tree evidence and cleanup receipts, commit and push each verified unit. Stop when this goal's criteria have current-tree evidence and cleanup receipts, or when the user reports quota exhaustion.
